videos.script: Temperature makes rare words rarer, but it never removes them. {{tail}} In a model with thousands of tokens, a long tail of unlikely words is always in the draw. {{draw}} Top-k and top-p cut that tail off before anything is drawn. {{cut}} Top-k keeps a fixed number of the best words. Two, say, or forty. {{topk}} Top-p keeps as many as it takes to reach a share, like eighty percent. {{topp}} When the model is sure, that is one word. When it is torn, it is several. {{adapt}} In this lesson you cut toylm's lists both ways and compare what survives. {{compare}} Then you combine them with temperature, and see that the order they run in changes the result. {{order}} By the end you know which control to reach for, and why to move one at a time. {{one}}
